name: Veal
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Choose lean cuts to minimize digestive stress.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Cook gently to maintain tenderness - avoid high heat which can make it tough
Pair with low-FODMAP vegetables for balanced nutrition
Avoid marinades containing garlic or onion - use garlic-infused oil instead
